evidence: the-status-page-is-refused-off-loopback: nginx_frontend.pp:254-260 declares /nginx_status with location_allow 127.0.0.1 and location_deny all; a request via the node's enp0s8 address expects 403, and the mismatch (127.0.0.1, the one allowed address) must change the verdict to 200 - supported

on-redhat-the-key-is-read-from-pki-tls-private: nginx_frontend.pp:87-99 sets ssl_private_dir /etc/pki/tls/private on RedHat, so ssl_key_path (:145) becomes /etc/pki/tls/private/p8test.key; the rhel9 variant greps ssl_certificate_key for that dir plus nginx -t - supported

a-backend-answers: nginx_frontend_domain.pp:409-412 declares the upstream from backend_hosts_and_ports (fixture 127.0.0.1:8080); the check is the lab-side backend setup the frontend checks proxy to, mutates declares the transient unit and the effect curls it - supported as setup

purpose gap: Tested: HTTP->HTTPS 301 on naked and www keeping path/query; HTTPS proxy to the backend under both names with certificate verification (and failure under other.example.com); TLS1.3-only; default server 404 over HTTP and HTTPS (mismatch); monitoring name in /etc/hosts, Hello World text/plain, stub_status to 127.0.0.1 and 403 off loopback (mismatch); the Nagios check OK/WARNING/CRITICAL; dyn variant proxying via $proxy_backend; rhel key path; prod rendering of letsencrypt bundle, timeouts, adhoc/other location config, header, protocols, pass suffix, www fix redirect.
